description: This file defines a controller pool for managing AbortControllers associated with message streaming sessions, allowing adding, stopping, removing, and checking for pending controllers.

methods.name: addController
methods.description: Adds a new AbortController to the pool associated with specific session and message identifiers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Aborts the streaming associated with a specific session and message.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Aborts all streaming controllers in the pool.

methods.name: hasPending
methods.description: Checks if there are any active (pending) streaming controllers.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific controller from the pool based on session and message identifiers.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for session and message identifiers to store and retrieve controllers.
